_comment: Policy-as-data for the cloud-ci-tier-dependency-acyclicity gate (Phase-0 capability-first reorg; ADR-0245/0280/0562). DATA, not code: the governed crate-root globs, the tier'd service roots, the unclassified meta roots, the ADR-0280 S-rank order, the false-green floor, and the enforcement mode. The Rust kernel hardcodes no repo fact; a different repo adopts the gate by repointing this policy. crate_root_globs mirror the root Cargo.toml workspace members (FRIC-1781069288/ADR-0538 globbed membership); the canonical resolver remains libs/oya-workspace-members-kernel — this list is the gate's own scan floor, kept in lockstep by the workspace-glob-coverage gate. enforcement is born advisory-baseline; flip to blocking only when tier-dependency-acyclicity-baseline.json reaches zero violations (post-strangler).
flip_to_blocking_trigger: Set enforcement to "blocking" when tier-dependency-acyclicity-baseline.json carries zero violations (the reorg strangler has fixed every substrate-inversion). Until then the gate reports baselined debt advisory-only and blocks ONLY on a NEW regression vs the frozen baseline.
_capability_roots_comment: ADR-0562 capability roots + the os/ meta dir: the ROOT IS THE SERVICE, so its tier lives at <root>/manifest.json, not <root>/<name>/manifest.json. Faces (core/ports/adapters/facade) are sub-folds of ONE two-pizza ownership boundary (ADR-0562 SS1/SS4), never sibling services. libs/ and tools/ stay unclassified: libs/ is the root the strangler dissolves (ADR-0562 SS9), so tier metadata authored there is discarded work.
_staged_roots_comment: billing and marketplace are STAGED OUT of this classification PR. Classifying them surfaces two genuine ADR-0245 R1 violations that were invisible while they resolved to service:null — billing/facade/saas-bench -> oya/application/crates/oya-saas-plugin-app and marketplace/facade/dev-cli -> oya/application/crates/oya-application-app. Per ADR-0617 (founder: ratchet-from-debt REJECTED in favour of fail-closed after a one-time cleanup) these must be FIXED, not baselined. Fixing them is product refactoring, which ADR-0512 forbids mixing into a structural PR (never merged concurrently in a PR drain). They classify in their own stage once the edges are cleaned. NOTE marketplace/facade/dev-cli is already slated for removal: ADR-0615 Q10 homes dev-cli under ci/ and de-CLIs it.
